description: Stores a prepared change in the local APPROVAL QUEUE (~/.suunto-mcp/approvals.json, SUUNTO_APPROVALS_PATH moves it; 0600) so the user can decide later. Writes only that file, never contacts Suunto and NEVER pushes anything: nothing reaches the watch unless the user approves with resolve_approval (decision approve AND push: true in the same call). `kind` 'adjusted_guide': `payload` is push_strength_guide's exact arguments (adjust_guide's `guide`; a guideId is refused); 'week_plan': `payload` is { guides } (propose_next_week's `guides`). The payload is validated as the push tool does (schema, then each guide built as a dry run); one that would not pass is refused and nothing is stored. `forDate` is the guide's day (the earliest for a week_plan): omit it or pass exactly that date; a guide dated before today is refused. `expiresAt` (ISO 8601) defaults to the end of forDate in server local time; earlier is allowed, later never. A `queuePayload` from propose_next_week or adjust_guide goes in as it is. At most 1000 approvals; none is deleted automatically. Demo mode keeps the queue in memory.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 moment after which it can no longer be approved; at most the end of forDate.

forDate.description: Optional: must equal the guide's own date (the earliest for a week_plan), the default.

kind.description: adjusted_guide (one strength guide) or week_plan ({ guides }).

payload.description: The exact arguments of the push tool: a guide spec for adjusted_guide, { guides: [...] } for week_plan.

reasons.description: Short sentences shown with the approval.

name: queue_adjustment
title: Queue a prepared change for the user's approval (local file, pushes nothing)
